title: [Bug]: Gemini Client does not have callbacks for async methods (achat, acomplete)
body:
### Bug Description

Hi,

We noticed that we were not receiving instrumentation when using Gemini models. 

After digging a bit in the code, it seems the `.achat` and `.acomplete` method in the Gemini client ([/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-gemini/llama_index/llms/gemini/base.py](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/blob/d22fdcd2c1d09bfa66b2370b8ea2d5680d89cd63/llama-index-integrations/llms/llama-index-llms-gemini/llama_index/llms/gemini/base.py)) do not have the `@llm_completion_callback()` and `@llm_chat_callback()`. What is strange is that the `.complete` and `. chat` method have the decorators.

Is there a particular reason why this has not beed added? Maybe the original reason is not valid anymore and they can be simply added?

Happy to open a PR if that is a simple fix

### Version

0.12.14

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Setup some instrumentation (e.g. a custom EventHandler following [the doc](https://docs.llamaindex.ai/en/stable/module_guides/observability/instrumentation/#using-the-instrumentation-module-for-observability)) 
2. Make an async query with a Gemini model
``` 
from llama_index.llms.gemini import Gemini

flash2 = Gemini(model="models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp")
await flash2.acomplete("Write your best joke about pirates.")
```

3. Run and see that the instrumentation is never called. Models like OpenAI trigger the instrumentation.

### Relevant Logs/Tracbacks

(no failures, just nothing happens)
